primary_reason: West whole-server monthly is contract-homogeneous and has the richest time variation among the two regional monthly H100 series: 43 observations, 11 unique daily average levels and 10 non-zero log-change days.
robustness_reason: Yangtze whole-server monthly has the same contract/hardware form and 43 observations, but fewer distinct levels (6) and fewer change days (5); it is retained to quantify regional basis/model risk.
national_short_term_reason: The nationwide single-card short-term retail series is retained only as a cross-sectional/contract-basis reference because it is extremely sticky: zero-change share=0.979167.
pricing_calibration_guardrail: Do not replace the 92-day Ornn physical Log-OU calibration with these shorter SMM regional histories. Use SMM for China empirical application, regional/global basis evidence and robustness.
composite_guardrail: Do not create a weighted China composite yet. Primary and robustness series remain separate because regional return innovations are not assumed identical and no defensible market-share weights are available.
